Release notes

What changed in each new version, and what to know before updating.

  1. 2026.11.06v0.7.2

    0.7.2 — Stroke shortcuts, previews and HereSphere beta

    Adjust the stroke minimum and maximum from the keyboard or a gamepad, and preview videos in the file list. Ratings backup, opening files from the command line and a HereSphere beta are new.

    →
  2. 2026.10.24v0.7.1

    0.7.1 — Script-only playback and axis recording

    Play a funscript without any video, and record one axis with a slider to save as a new funscript. Playlist cleanup and recovery of per-video settings are new too.

    →
  3. 2026.10.10v0.7.1-beta.1

    0.7.1-beta.1 — Test build for a Handy script loading fix

    A Windows test build that fixes Handy preparation failures with some scripts. It is a manual-download beta; automatic updates stay on 0.7.0.

    →
  4. 2026.10.10v0.7.0

    0.7.0 — Per-video motion settings and library organization

    Adds per-axis response curves and per-video motion settings. Scripts you pick by hand are remembered, and tags and smart groups help organize the library.

    →
